document_id.description: Unique identifier for the document, usually including media code, date, and page or broadcast info, e.g. 'NZZ-1808-05-24-a-p0004'

publication_title.description: Name of the media source, e.g. 'Neue Zürcher Zeitung'

time_period.description: Time period during which this media source was active, e.g. '1780-1950'

source_type.description: Type of the media source, e.g. 'Newspaper', 'Radio Broadcast'...

date.description: Date of publication in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), if only the year is known (YYYY-01-01) or null if unknown

text.description: OCR text of the document or transcript, including newlines

sampled_pairs.description: Custom number of proximity sampled person–location pairs from the document.

pers_entity_id.description: The entity_id of the person entity in this pair

pers_wikidata_QID.description: Wikidata QID for the person entity if available, or null if unknown

pers_mentions_list.description: All unique mention strings referring to this person entity

loc_entity_id.description: The entity_id of the location entity in this pair

loc_wikidata_QID.description: Wikidata QID for the location entity if available, or null if unknown

loc_mentions_list.description: All unique mention strings referring to this location entity

at.description: Indicates whether the person was at the location judging from textual evidence. Any cells left as 'NULL' will be treated as 'FALSE' during evaluation.

at_explanation.description: Optional but useful explanation for the at judgment.

isAt.description: Indicates whether there is evidence that the person was at the location within roughly two weeks before the article's publication. Any cells left as 'NULL' will be treated as 'FALSE' during evaluation.

isAt_explanation.description: Optional but usefule explanation for the at/isAt judgment.
